decision.summary: Two regions merit closer inspection: (1) an abrupt multi-sample shift near index 618–620 in E/U with supporting N change, and (2) a prolonged high-amplitude fluctuating segment from ~680 onward with no obvious reversal, possibly indicating complex superposed motion or data anomaly.

regions.observation: Sharp multi-sample jump in E and U components around index 618–620, with E increasing from ~30 to ~32 and U dropping from ~-17 to ~-19; N shows a smaller concurrent rise. The change is abrupt and sustained, not clearly reversed within the window.

Extended region (starting ~680) showing persistent high-amplitude oscillation in E (~30–36) and U (~-20 to -24), with N fluctuating between ~13–18; includes a notable spike at index 700 (E=35.7, U=-21.5) and later gradual drift. No clear platform or return, but morphology suggests superposed motion or data artifact rather than simple offset.
